_comment: Real /api/geo/flood-model inundation zones, retrieved live 2026-09-01, trimmed to a representative sample of each MultiPolygon's parts. Full output is 31k-68k vertices per site, which the MapLibre testing guidelines forbid checking into a suite; what is kept is the structure that matters for rendering - four hazard classes, depth bands, and many-part MultiPolygons rather than the single triangles the other map tests use.
